chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Zurara, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'When the performer of Umra arrives in Makkah and performs Tawaf and Sa'ee, if he wishes, let him proceed upon his mount and let him join his family.'

key_terms.سَعَى: Performed Sa'ee (walking between Safa and Marwa)

ai.seo_question: When can a pilgrim end their Umra rituals and return home?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the flexibility of Umrah rituals, establishing that the completion of Tawaf and Sa'ee suffices for the pilgrim to conclude their pilgrimage and return home. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that Umrah is a distinct, self-contained act of worship, contrasting with Hajj where staying in Mina and performing additional rites are obligatory components of the ritual structure.
